note: October 2026 Price to Compare by investor-owned utility. Ohio Edison, AEP Ohio, Duke Energy Ohio, and AES Ohio rates match sourced rows in forge_corrected_dataset.csv. The Illuminating Company and Toledo Edison figures were checked on the PUCO Energy Choice Apples to Apples pages on 2026-10-15. Both official residential prices match the previously unsourced figures (11.24 and 11.26 cents/kWh), so those amounts were kept. 11.262 values in the dataset are SOPEC aggregation rates, not the Toledo Edison Price to Compare. On 2026-10-15 the Ohio Edison, AEP Ohio, Duke Energy Ohio, and AES Ohio pages were checked again. Official residential prices matched the stored cents, so those amounts were kept and the earlier source notes remain on each row. Effective dates were added from the pages: Ohio Edison and AEP Ohio run October 1 through December 31, 2026; Duke Energy Ohio runs October 1 through October 31, 2026; AES Ohio runs June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027.
